title: FRENCH GRADE 4
text:
HOLIDAY ASSIGNMENT
 GRADE 4 FRENCH
COMPLETE GRADE FOUR HOME ASSIGNMENT
 FRENCH GRADE 4
 1. Draw and colour the flag of Kenya and France.
 2. Write the names of the following in French.
 i.) Tower
 ii.) Tortoise
 iii.) Bottle
 3. Write down the names of the week in French.
 a) Monday
 b) Tuesday
 c) Wednesday
 d) Thursday
 e) Friday
 f) Saturday
 g) Sunday
 4. Rearrange the following.
 O N E
 A U
 B M T
 R U E S
 5. Bonsoir! is good morning while goodnight in French is?
